description: This file defines the ForLoopTask class, a workflow activity for implementing a for-loop within OrchardCore workflows. It includes properties for start, end, step, and loop variable, and handles execution logic for iteration.

classes.name: ForLoopTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for executing a for-loop with configurable start, end, step, and loop variable.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the display text for the activity, localized as 'For Loop Task'.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the activity, localized as 'Control Flow'.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Provides the possible outcomes of the activity: 'Iterate' and 'Done'.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes the loop logic asynchronously, evaluating expressions and determining whether to continue looping or finish.
